stem: What can be inferred about a city that reports planting many saplings but does not track their survival?
options: Its planting total may overstate the lasting shade and cooling the programme will provide.
Its residents will receive immediate cooling because saplings release water vapour.
Its hottest districts will necessarily gain the greatest number of mature trees.
Its tree programme will reduce the need for reliable public services during heat waves.

verdicts.working: The passage says saplings may not survive and take years to provide substantial shade, so planting totals alone can overstate lasting benefits.

working: The passage says counting saplings alone is a poor measure: young trees may not survive and take years to provide substantial shade. Thus, planting totals may exaggerate lasting benefits.
